mapper.sql: select notice_id, course_id, course_name, notice_title, notice_content, publisher_id, publisher_name, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from edu_course_notice
mapper.select: where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and course_id = #{courseId} order by notice_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into edu_course_notice(course_id, course_name, notice_title, notice_content, publisher_id, publisher_name, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{courseId}, #{courseName}, #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeContent}, #{publisherId}, #{publisherName}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update edu_course_notice set course_id=#{courseId}, course_name=#{courseName}, notice_title=#{noticeTitle}, notice_content=#{noticeContent}, status=#{status}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate(), remark=#{remark} where notice_id=#{noticeId}
update edu_course_notice set del_flag = '2' where notice_id in #{noticeId}
